source: spec v1 §8.1 'Projection format p1'; crates/maverick-core/src/projection.rs; generated by crates/maverick-core/tests/projection.rs
text_encoding: A text is an array of segments, concatenated. {"text": s} is s. {"repeat": c, "count": n} is the character c repeated n times.
how_to_run: For each case, build the body text, parse it as JSON (or pass the bytes), and project it. expect null means no projection (send the declared fallback). Otherwise the projection text and the truncated flag must match exactly. For each workload_header case, parse the value; compare with expect or expect_error.
